north_star: Pass the frozen full-Vocos host numerical gate under strict exact/equivalent semantics where possible, then complete host structural qualification, then only final target-device qualification and production integration in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android.

current_gap.interpretation: The remaining max gap is large (~27.1%). Tiny sub-material tweaks are not an adequate strategic plan.

decision_nodes.now_action: Run QNN2.44 CPU Stage1 for exactly A_local_max, B_local_rmse, C_p90_blockmax.
decision_nodes.why: Test whether intermediate partial-guided tree selection transfers to full-graph final-spectrum improvement without using warm18.
decision_nodes.if_pass: If exactly one preregistered material winner exists, only that winner may open Stage2.
decision_nodes.if_fail: Close the partial-guided balanced-tree selector family. Do not add more selectors/trees merely because the search space is easy to enumerate.

decision_nodes.condition: Only if H1 yields a unique material winner.
decision_nodes.action: Run winner-only Stage2 on the frozen validation blocks and apply the preregistered non-regression/material rule.
decision_nodes.if_fail: Close this reduction-tree candidate/family; do not rescue it by tuning against Stage2.

decision_nodes.action: Run the unique winner on Stage3 including warm18, then assemble full47 from the three preregistered stages without rerunning already-scored blocks.
decision_nodes.if_material_improvement_and_gate_pass: Promote and immediately leave search mode for Phase B host qualification.
decision_nodes.if_material_improvement_but_gate_still_f: Promote the new best, then perform a fresh nonperturbing localization/conditioning diagnostic BEFORE proposing another family. Do not simply keep enumerating reduction trees.

decision_nodes.condition: Reached if current partial-guided tree mechanism closes or a promoted tree still leaves max_abs > 3e-4.
decision_nodes.action: Run one fresh causal diagnostic phase on the then-current host best to identify a genuinely distinct remaining intrinsic source or downstream amplification mechanism. Any new exact/equivalent family must be justified by that evidence and must state plausible leverage toward the remaining max gap.
decision_nodes.route_switch: After the current tree mechanism, allow at most ONE further causally distinct exact/equivalent family unless new evidence materially changes the causal model. If no such mechanism is supported, or that distinct family fails the material-improvement gate, declare the exact/equivalent route causally exhausted and activate the preserved learned-residual / wider-student / surrogate contingency instead of continuing micro-tuning.

after_host_numerical_gate: only then minimal strict APK/device A/B/C final truth in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android
strategic_rule: EXACT_NEXT controls the next command; NEXT_HORIZON controls why that command exists and where to go after each possible result; ROADMAP controls the project north star. None may silently override the others.
